prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production equipment item icons (jewelry accessories) for a dark fantasy 2D action RPG. Image1 is the existing equipment sheet of this game: match its finely detailed pixel-illustrated painterly style, dark outlines, lighting and scale. Create ONE transparent RGBA square image with exactly FIVE separate items in an invisible 3 columns x 2 rows grid, row 1 cells 1-3, row 2 cells 4-5, and the sixth cell (bottom-right) left completely EMPTY. Each item centered in its own cell with wide transparent margins, never touching each other or the canvas edge, each item compact and filling about 60% of its cell: (1) a silver earring shaped like a small lightning bolt with a storm-blue gem and tiny wing (STORM SKY ISLAND theme), (2) a silver and sky-blue seal medallion engraved with spread wings around a thundercloud (STORM SKY ISLAND theme), (3) a necklace pendant of a radiant golden sun disc with a dusk-violet gem on a gold chain (TWILIGHT DIVINE REALM theme), (4) a gold earring shaped like a small halo with a hanging violet-amber gem (TWILIGHT DIVINE REALM theme), (5) an ornate gold seal medallion with a twilight sun eclipse emblem, white marble inlay and violet glow (TWILIGHT DIVINE REALM theme). Each item is a single object (an earring is ONE single earring, not a pair). Each item clearly readable at small icon size and clearly distinct from the others. Actual alpha transparency, no background, no floor, no shadow, no text, no labels, no characters.
